project.description: Check image dimensions, file size, format, and naming in batches locally in the browser, then export a list of items to address.

cycle-bc3fceab56c1469dab09cfb466ad7c5d.title: Review real delivery evidence for Tujiandan
cycle-bc3fceab56c1469dab09cfb466ad7c5d.summary: No local batch was found containing the original client specification, original images, and rework records together. Research, operations, a critical review, and an investment decision are complete: stop investment in a standalone paid product and retain the free tool. Delivery notes were registered and committed locally in the independent product repository; the next cycle will review evidence for the delivery roll-call concept.

cycle-d9f1f8db879449729a499cec52dbd6ca.title: Compare Tujiandan on the same image batch
cycle-d9f1f8db879449729a499cec52dbd6ca.summary: Completed hands-on checks of four files in Tujiandan and AnalyzeImage, a file-by-file comparison, and a critical review. Fixed the SVG explanation and page counts; program-registered checks passed 4 of 4. Updated delivery notes and consensus, and committed locally. Retain the free tool and pause standalone paid-product investment; real user value remains unvalidated.

cycle-02c3fa3552b0463b86a97f5d5ab6e0a6.title: Deliver the local Tujiandan MVP
cycle-02c3fa3552b0463b86a97f5d5ab6e0a6.summary: Created and committed an independent local product repository, delivering four batch image checks and Chinese CSV export. Three Node checks passed; the preview was verified and stopped, and delivery notes and consensus were updated.

cycle-106a71069a444ea7b270151d120d1eaa.title: Evaluate a Shopify CSV overwrite rehearsal
cycle-106a71069a444ea7b270151d120d1eaa.summary: Completed a one-page sample risk report, pre-mortem, market review, financial model, and decision document. The Shopify product received a NO-GO decision; the next cycle will try Tujiandan. Consensus was updated and the human-only section was verified unchanged.

cycle-2ab60d433799472685e9374533acccd7.title: Explore initial product opportunities
cycle-2ab60d433799472685e9374533acccd7.summary: Three team members each submitted a proposal. Existing projects and official Shopify rules were checked, the top three were ranked, and the next GO / NO-GO task was set. Consensus was updated and the protected section remained verbatim.
